title: skills(automation): value slots take a CEL envelope or a literal; the single-brace dialect leaves the skill text
body:
Fixes #22585

Clause-②: no

The `objectstack-automation` skill still taught the single-brace `{…}` template dialect as a kept value-slot spelling — `{$User.PATH}` and the date macros at `:233`, the run-user remedy through `{$User.Id}` / `{NOW()}` at `:238`, and the lines the card's pointer comments name (`:65`, `:68`, `:107`, `:114`, `:115`, `:154`, `:159`–`:163`, `:197`–`:212`, `:240`, `:268`, `:273`) — after the platform retired that dialect from every flow value slot and text slot and refuses each such token at `objectstack validate`, `registerFlow`, the save door and the executor's parse. This PR makes the three published texts say what the platform accepts, and nothing it refuses. ⛔ Nothing under `packages/**` changes: the platform on `main` is the ruling the text follows.

## What the text now teaches, and the tree reading behind each spelling

Every spelling written into the skill has a reading on `origin/main` at `6d96721faa`:

| Taught | Read from |
|:--|:--|
| A value slot (`assignments.*`, `fields.*`, `subflow` / `map` `input.*`, `script` `inputs.*`, `loop` / `map` `collection`, notify `recipients` / `templateData.*` / `sourceId`, `http` `body`, each CRUD `filter` operand) takes a CEL value envelope or a literal; a `{…}` token is refused naming its CEL spelling | `packages/spec/src/automation/flow-value-slot-template.ts` module header (the slot inventory, "Refused, not converted"); `FlowValueSlotSchema` at `builtin-node-config.zod.ts:1347,1365`, `io-node-config.zod.ts:540,586,622,965` |
| Text slots (notify `title` / `message` / `actionUrl`, screen `title` / `description`, end `message`, `http` `url` / `headers`) render `{{ }}` holes; a date or the run user has no hole — assign it, then `{{ v }}` | `flow-text-slot-template.ts` header and its refusal text at `:337`–`:339` (`assignments: { v: { dialect: 'cel', source: 'current_user.id' } }` then `{{ v }}`); `io-node-config.zod.ts:632` (`actionUrl` renders `{{ }}` holes, example `/crm_case/{{ record.id }}`) |
| Run user: `current_user.id`, guarded `current_user != null ? current_user.id : null`; `current_user` holds `id`, `positions`, `organizationId`, `isPlatformAdmin` only — an email or a name is a `sys_user` read by that id | `packages/services/service-automation/src/engine.ts:12052`–`12066` (`current_user` bound from `runUserOf(context)`, `null` without a user); `flow-value-slot-template.ts` "The run user" section |
| Dates: `isoDate(today())`, `isoDate(daysFromNow(N))` / `isoDate(daysAgo(N))`, `isoDatetime(now())`, `isoDatetime(addDays(now(), N))` | `flow-value-slot-template.ts` "The date macros" section; `packages/formula/src/stdlib.ts:383,387` (`isoDate` / `isoDatetime`), `validate.ts:1271`–`1272` (`addDays`, `daysFromNow`, `daysAgo` in the bare-callable set) |
| Deep-path guard `has(vars.source) && has(vars.source.id) ? vars.source.id : null` | `flow-template-token.ts:160`–`:186` (`vars` is the variables namespace; `FLOW_SCOPE_CLAIMED_IDENTIFIERS`) |
| Loop / map `collection`: an envelope (`{ dialect: 'cel', source: 'rows' }`) or an inline list, never a string | `flow-value-slot-template.ts` "A loop's or a map's collection" (`FlowCollectionSlotSchema` refuses a token-free string); `builtin-node-config.zod.ts:1347` |
| Notify `recipients`: an id, a list, or an envelope evaluating to an id, a list or `null`; a CSV string is ONE recipient | `packages/services/service-automation/src/builtin/notify-node.ts:185`–`:240` (`resolveRecipients`: "a string is one recipient as written"; the comma-joined phantom is retired) |
| RAW notify keys are read as written; a `{token}` there is refused | `flow-node-config-refusals.ts:439`–`:446` (`READ_AS_WRITTEN_PARAM`: `sourceObject`, `actorId`, `payload`); `io-node-config.zod.ts:638` (`payload` refusal text) |
| CRUD `filter`: a whole-string query placeholder (`{current_user_id}`, `{today}`, `{current_year_start}`) passes through; every other `{…}` token is refused (`expression-invalid`); a flow variable never shadows a placeholder | `flow-value-slot-template.ts` "A CRUD node's filter operands"; `classifyFlowFilterOperandString` over `isKnownFilterToken` (`packages/spec/src/data/context-tokens.zod.ts:332`: context tokens + `DATE_MACRO_TOKENS`, lowercase `today` etc. — `TODAY()` is not one) |
| An operand that evaluates to `null` refuses the node, not `fault`-routable; route around with a `decision`, write the literal `null` to match an empty field | `packages/services/service-automation/src/builtin/crud-nodes.ts:44`–`:115` (`resolveNodeFilter` → `refuseNode(...)` at `:492`, `:736`, `:837`) |
| A relation hop in an envelope needs the start node's `config.expand` to list the field | S4 contract-review teaching note on the card; `engine.ts:6226` (`expandDeclaredLookups`) |
| Fault handler reads `{{ NODE_ID.error }}` / `{{ $error.message }}`, in CEL `vars["$error"]` | `engine.ts:11027` (`setNodeError` publishes the message under the node id); `builtin/template.ts:52`–`:56` (`{{ $error.message }}` is a hole); `flow-template-token.ts:179`–`:183` (a `$`-named head reads through `vars`) |
| `expression-invalid` replaces the retired lint rule `flow-filter-token-unknown` | `packages/lint/src/authoring-rules.ts:542`; `git grep flow-filter-token-unknown` on `main` hits only changelogs / release notes / the S6 changeset |

The spelling in the skill's fault-handler sentence is the placeholder NODE_ID in angle brackets; this body spells it `NODE_ID` because the body sanitizer eats angle-bracket fragments.

## Line-by-line before → after (`skills/objectstack-automation/SKILL.md`, line numbers at `6d96721faa`)

- `:65` loop row — before: `once per item of `config.collection`; `iteratorVariable` …` → after: `once per item of `config.collection` — a CEL value envelope (`{ dialect: 'cel', source: 'rows' }`) or an inline list, never a string; `iteratorVariable` …`
- `:68` map row — before: `invoke a subflow once per item of a collection; each iteration may pause` → after: `invoke a subflow once per item of `config.collection` (shaped as `loop`'s); each iteration may pause`
- `:102`–`:103` — before: `**RAW** keys never interpolate: a `{token}` in one is forwarded verbatim, never resolved.` → after: `**RAW** keys are read as written: a `{token}` in one is refused.`
- `:107` — before: `recipients: '{record.assignee}',   // REQUIRED — id, CSV, or string[]` → after: `recipients: { dialect: 'cel', source: 'record.assignee' }, // REQUIRED — id, list, or envelope; a CSV is ONE id`
- `:114` — before: `sourceId: '{record.id}',           //   at execute time` → after: `sourceId: { dialect: 'cel', source: 'record.id' }, // (a value slot)`
- `:115` — before: `actionUrl: 'https://…/tasks/123',  // overrides the synthesized link` → after: `actionUrl: '/tasks/{{ record.id }}', // text slot; overrides the synthesized link`
- `:154`–`:155` — before: `The handler reads `{NODE_ID.error}` (or run-wide `{$error}`). The run then reports success, …` → after: `The handler reads `{{ NODE_ID.error }}` (or run-wide `{{ $error.message }}`; in CEL, `vars["$error"]`). The run then reports success, …`
- `:159` (does-not-route cell) — before: `filter token that resolved to nothing` → after: `filter operand that evaluated to `null``
- `:161`–`:163` — before: the paragraph `Routing a guard refusal is worse than the failure: a dropped filter condition **widens** the query, so a routed `delete_record` empties the object while the run reports success. `objectstack validate` names the offending template.` → after: deleted here; its lesson is the second bullet of the rewritten filter section below.
- `:197`–`:212` — before: `### Filter tokens (`config.filter`)` with the two bullets *Precedence — flow variables win, placeholders pass through* (the flow template engine runs first; a flow variable named after a placeholder shadows it; `{current_year_start}` in `url` is nonsense) and *Static checkability splits by position* (a `{record.…}` token inside a filter is an ERROR at validate, the condition is DROPPED; outside a filter it renders empty; a `{var}` is not statically checkable) → after: `### Filter operands (`config.filter`)` with two bullets: *Each operand is a value slot* — a literal or a CEL envelope evaluated before the query (`filter: { id: { dialect: 'cel', source: 'record.id' } }`); a whole-string query placeholder (`{current_user_id}`, `{today}`, `{current_year_start}`) passes through; every other `{…}` token is refused (`expression-invalid`) with its envelope; a flow variable never shadows a placeholder; only `filter` gets this hand-off, in a text slot `{{ current_year_start }}` is nonsense — and *An operand that evaluates to `null` refuses the node* (not `fault`-routable): a dropped condition widens the query, so a routed `delete_record` would empty the object; route around with a `decision`; write the literal `null` to match an empty field; a relation hop (`record.owner.email`) needs the start node's `config.expand`, else the fault names the missing hop.
- `:221`–`:243` (Valid-but-silently-wrong item 1) — before: `**A `fields` / `assignment` VALUE is a literal or a CEL envelope.**` scoped to `fields.*` and `assignment`, the three remedies, then `still accepted there until CEL can write them: `{NOW()}` / `{TODAY() ± N}` and `{$User.PATH}``; a text-slot paragraph saying `{$User.Id}` / `{NOW()}` have no hole and `Every other slot (`recipients`, `inputs`, `http`, `filter`) keeps the SINGLE-brace template: `{record.tags.0}`, `{TODAY() + 30}`, `{round(x)}`; no `{…}` ⇒ literal.`; and `❌ `'{ROUND(x, 2)}'` — an unknown name in call position **fails the node** at run time, unchecked at build, not `fault`-routable.` → after: `**A value slot takes a literal or a CEL envelope — never a `{…}` token.**` naming every value slot (`assignments.*`, `fields.*`, `subflow` / `map` `input.*`, `script` `inputs.*`, `loop` / `map` `collection`, notify `recipients` / `templateData.*` / `sourceId`, `http` `body`, every CRUD `filter` operand); the `record.owner` and `record.tags[0]` remedies kept and the deep-path guard `has(vars.source) && has(vars.source.id) ? vars.source.id : null` added; the money remedy kept; `dates:` `{TODAY()}` → `isoDate(today())`, `{TODAY() ± N}` → `isoDate(daysFromNow(N))` / `isoDate(daysAgo(N))`, `{NOW()}` → `isoDatetime(now())`, `{NOW() ± N}` → `isoDatetime(addDays(now(), N))`; `run user:` `{$User.Id}` → `current_user.id`, guarded `current_user != null ? current_user.id : null`, `current_user` holds `id`, `positions`, `organizationId`, `isPlatformAdmin` only, an email or a name is a `sys_user` read by that id; the text-slot paragraph now lists notify `title` / `message` / `actionUrl`, screen `title` / `description`, end `message`, `http` `url` / `headers`, says a `{…}` token there is refused with its `{{ }}` spelling, and gives the remedy `assignments: { v: { dialect: 'cel', source: 'current_user.id' } }` then `{{ v }}`. The `:240` kept-list and the `❌ '{ROUND(x, 2)}'` line are deleted (a `{…}` token is refused at build now; item 4 keeps "an unknown function fails the build").
- `:268` — before: `inputs: { ticketId: '{record.id}' },   // inputs are interpolated` → after: `inputs: { ticketId: { dialect: 'cel', source: 'record.id' } }, // CEL values or literals`
- `:273` — before: `filter: { id: '{record.id}' },` → after: `filter: { id: { dialect: 'cel', source: 'record.id' } },`
- `:291`–`:296` (item 4, paid for the additions) — before: the stdlib function list `now()`, `today()`, `daysFromNow(n)`, `daysAgo(n)`, `daysBetween(a, b)`, `isBlank(v)`, `coalesce(a, b)`, `abs/round/min/max`, `upper/lower/contains/matches`, plus CEL built-ins … → after: `The table is **objectstack-formula**'s `CEL_STDLIB_FUNCTIONS`, the bare-callable public subset; receiver methods (called on a value, never bare) are not in it.` The list has its home in `skills/objectstack-formula/SKILL.md` (`:134`–`:189`); the rule sentence that follows (an unknown function and a `{…}`-wrapped ref fail the build) is unchanged.
- `:308` (paid for the additions) — before: the pointer to `references/state-machines-and-approvals.md` followed by its nine section titles and the introspection route `GET /api/v1/meta/object/:name/state/:field?from=:state` → after: the pointer followed by `` — its state-introspection route is `GET /api/v1/meta/object/:name/state/:field?from=:state`. `` (one line, +0 lines net). The nine titles are in that file (`:47`, `:143`, `:199`, `:222`, `:236`, `:354`); the route stays here because `packages/rest/src/meta-state-route-doc-spelling.test.ts` pins `skills/objectstack-automation/SKILL.md` as a site that teaches the path the REST ledger row for `meta.getLegalNextStates` declares — `Test Core (2/6)` on `58792214b1` was red on exactly that pin, green on `5edd150ea3`.

`skills/objectstack-automation/evals/flows-triggers-approvals.json`:
- `:7` eval 1 `expected_output` — before: `` `renewal_date: { $lt: '{TODAY()}' }` `` → after: `` `renewal_date: { $lt: '{today}' }` `` (`TODAY()` is not a query placeholder, so the retired flow token was refused at the operand; `{today}` is the query engine's own macro and passes through).
- `:17` eval 2 `expected_output` — before: `` `recipients: '{record.owner_id}'` `` … `Reminds that `requires` must list `automation`, `triggers` and `messaging` (otherwise notify reports success with `skipped: true`).` → after: `` `recipients: { dialect: 'cel', source: 'record.owner_id' }` `` … ``requires` must list `automation`, `triggers` and `messaging`, else notify reports success with `skipped: true`.` The graded `assertions` are unchanged.
- Control: `git grep -n -E '\{\$User|\{NOW\(\)|\{TODAY\(\)|\{record\.id\}|\{rows\}' HEAD -- skills/objectstack-automation/evals` → 0 hits after; 1 hit (`:7`) before. Eval 2's `'{record.owner_id}'` was outside that pattern and found by reading the file whole.

A `{FUNC()}` neither dialect resolves is `flow-filter-token-unknown`: that node cannot run at all.`` → after: `` `update_record` / `delete_record` refuse the step instead of running it. ## Acceptance notes

Noted, not fixed here (outside the claim's declared file surface; each is the same defect class, but paying its file's token ratchet is a judgment about which sentences go, so the mechanical in-place exemption does not hold):

Remedy: `'{today}'` for the plain macro; `{ dialect: 'cel', source: 'isoDate(daysFromNow(7))' }` for an offset. Token headroom there: 10. class a · reach: named producer, the `@objectstack/skills` catalog ships the file verbatim · dedupe: examples-flows TODAY filter envelope · automation references single-brace.

## 维护者速读(草稿)

**改了什么**:三份对外发布的技能文本——`skills/objectstack-automation/SKILL.md`、它的评测集 `evals/flows-triggers-approvals.json`、`skills/objectstack-query/rules/filters.md` 的一句话——不再把单花括号 `{…}` 模板写法(`{$User.Id}`、`{NOW()}`、`{TODAY() ± N}`、`'{record.id}'` 等)教成 flow 值槽仍然接受的写法。改后文本只教平台今天真正接受的形状:值槽写 CEL 值信封 `{ dialect: 'cel', source: '…' }` 或字面量;文本槽(通知标题/正文/链接、HTTP url/headers 等)写 `{{ }}` 洞;运行用户用 `current_user.id`(可能无用户运行的 flow 加守卫);日期用 `isoDate(today())` 一族;CRUD `filter` 的整串查询占位符(`{current_user_id}`、`{today}`)原样放行,其它 `{…}` 一律被拒。同时删掉了该文件里两段在别处已有正本的重复内容(CEL 标准库函数清单、参考文件的目录罗列),用来支付新增字数——技能 token 上限一个都没抬。

**为什么改**:平台已在 `objectstack validate`、`registerFlow`、保存门、执行器四处拒收这些旧写法并给出 CEL 处方。技能是 AI 作者读的第一手资料:它教的写法一写就被拒,作者白跑一轮;更糟的是它给的「补救」本身还是被拒的写法。装了 `@objectstack/skills` 的每个项目都会逐字读到这些行。

**风险与代价(含回滚)**:纯文本改动,不碰 `packages/**`、不碰任何运行时行为。风险只有一种——教错新写法;对此每一条写进技能的拼写都在 PR 正文表格里标了树上的读数来源(spec 的值槽/文本槽判定模块、执行器、CEL 标准库)。本地门禁全绿,`check:skill-examples` 对构建后的 spec 做了类型检查。回滚 = revert 本 PR(三个 commit),无数据迁移、无配置变化。参考目录下另有两个文件还在教旧写法(见 Acceptance notes),本 PR 未动,需另立单。
